description: This file contains the implementation of the AuditService for creating and querying audit records within an insurance management system. It implements methods to record audit entries and list them for specific entities.

classes.name: AuditServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for AuditService handling audit record creation and queries.

methods.name: audit
methods.description: Creates a new audit record with details about an action performed by a user and saves it to the repository.

methods.name: listForEntity
methods.description: Retrieves a list of audit entries associated with a specific entity type and ID, ordered by creation time.
